prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The true series shows consistent upward trend across both validation folds. Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), but ONLY_DWT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.541 correlation), while CWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (24.10). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 24.62) and seasonality variance (0.66) combined with different early/late horizon specialists suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance.
